int action
ref chair
ref bird
float px
float py
float pz
begin function {action}
 let bird := GetFormFromMod "Player Vertibird.esm" "000E05"
 let chair := GetFormFromMod "Vertibird Player Home - pilot inside.esp" "000C20"
 if action == 2
  bird.MoveTo player 0 1600 0
  bird.SetAngle Z 0
  bird.Enable
  bird.SetVariable "ForceLand" 1
  Call (GetFormFromMod "Player Vertibird.esm" "014E6E")
 elseif action == 8
  bird.SetVariable "ForceLand" 0
  bird.SetVariable "State" 0
  bird.PlayGroup Right 1
 elseif action == 4
  SetFunctionValue (bird.GetPos X)
  return
 elseif action == 5
  SetFunctionValue (bird.GetPos Y)
  return
 elseif action == 6
  SetFunctionValue (bird.GetPos Z)
  return
 elseif action == 7
  let bird := GetFormFromMod "Player Vertibird.esm" "000AF2"
  bird.Activate player 1
 elseif action == 11
  chair.Activate player 1
 elseif action == 3
  bird.Activate player 1
 endif
 SetFunctionValue 1
end
